title: Fermentation
description: Without air, yeast splits sugar into alcohol and carbon dioxide for a little energy: bread, beer, and biogas. Unlocks Yeast Cultures, cheap Nutrient Broth and biogas.

puzzle.goal: Yeast grows on sugar S as μ·S/(K + S), but sugar Q or more holds it back by e^(−S/Q). Write the growth rate G.
puzzle.name: Haldane growth
puzzle.form: μ * S / ( K + S ) * exp ( - S / Q )
puzzle.expr: μ * S / ( K + S ) * exp ( - S / Q )
puzzle.ask: Find G for μ = @{μ}, S = @{S}, K = @{K} and Q = @{Q}.
puzzle.method: Monod's saturation S/(K + S) times the inhibition e^(−S/Q); the best sugar is √(KQ).
